correctness.rationale: The motion-and-copy event rates, including same-site copying, yield the stated current. The repaired founder proof explains the factor of two by splitting the preserved and newborn label lineages, and uses positive fixation probabilities to transform the operator into an irreducible Markov generator and justify the normalized solve. Independently, I solved the stationary count and coloured-absorption systems with rational matrices built from named-particle events. Cramer's rule bounds the respective numerator and common-denominator degrees by 9 and 36, so clearing denominators against the displayed formula gives degree at most 57. The difference vanishes at 58 distinct exact interior contrasts, hence identically. Both linear problems are nonsingular at every admissible contrast by irreducibility and almost-sure absorption. Positivity of both denominator and both residual numerator factors proves the sign, including the unique zero at equal killing. The replay also reproduces the off-family benchmark and obtains the N=4 Taylor coefficients (0,0,0,-1/157300,0) through order four. The N>=4 general expansion is cited background, not a new computation.
residual_risks: No all-contrast larger-population claim, arbitrary-killing classification, or formal verification.
